brand.name: A777ANCE
brand.app_desc: The internal operator console for the A777ance guild — one installable view over the whole funnel: brand, demand, funnel, sales, the Statement, payments, recruiting, compliance, and the automations that carry a record stage-to-stage.

lead: The machine around the Statement, on one screen. Every card below is a stage of the lifecycle — how a stranger becomes a household with a monthly Statement, and how a household becomes an operator who produces Statements for others. Each opens its spec; the cross-repo links reach the product (localDNS) and the model (MARKETING).

phases.label: The product
phases.blurb: What they pay for, every month — the center everything else surrounds.

phases.label: Earn the first Statement
phases.blurb: Find a household, win its trust, close it, and bill it — everything above the pay-for-value line.

phases.label: Spin the flywheel
phases.blurb: Turn a happy customer's raised hand into the next operator.

phases.label: The platform underneath
phases.blurb: Brand, storefront, the system of record, and the glue every other stage stands on.

stages.title: Brand Identity
stages.tool: Figma + brand asset host / press kit
stages.golive: Export assets; update the brand-kit links everything inherits
stages.tagline: The look, voice, and marks every surface inherits.
stages.summary: The single source of truth for palette, type, logo usage, and voice — “pest control, not lawn care; your home, by name.” Every downstream surface links to the brand kit rather than hard-coding a value, so a brand change is a one-file edit plus a Figma re-export.
stages.status_note: Palette and type tokens are still CHANGE_ME; voice and usage rules are set.

stages.title: Web Presence
stages.tool: Squarespace / WordPress · Google Business Profile · GitHub Pages
stages.golive: Publish site; verify GBP listing; Pages deploys from localDNS
stages.tagline: The storefront: site, Google Business Profile, the Statements gallery.
stages.summary: The public face a lead lands on after an ad or a search, and the verified local listing that earns trust. The Statements gallery is published from localDNS as the proof surface this storefront points to.

stages.title: Demand Generation
stages.tool: Meta / Google Ads · local SEO · Mailchimp
stages.golive: Launch campaign; sync the geo-targeted audience
stages.tagline: “Pest control for your network” — local SEO, geo-targeted ads, email.
stages.summary: Teaches a category the household doesn't know it needs, zip code by zip code, and writes a lead record the CRM can segment. Owns the positioning line and the geo-targeting that keeps spend local and dense.

stages.title: Funnels & Capture
stages.tool: Landing pages + intake form + Setmore + demo
stages.golive: Publish funnel; wire form → CRM (08) via automations (11)
stages.tagline: Landing page → intake form → self-booking → demo.
stages.summary: Converts a click into a booked consult and a CRM lead with intake answers attached — no human retyping. The hand-off into the system of record is the seam automations (11) must carry.

stages.title: Phone & Comms
stages.golive: Set hours, greeting, call routing; log every call to the CRM
stages.tagline: Answer the call, confirm the visit — the human touch, logged.
stages.summary: The voice that confirms a booking and reassures a first-time household, with every call logged back to its record. Calm and specific, never a phone tree — the trust-first stage between booking and consult.

stages.title: Sales & Onboarding
stages.tool: CRM + proposal / e-sign → handoff to localDNS deploy
stages.golive: Send quote; on close, provision the stack and collect setup fee
stages.tagline: Consult, quote, setup fee, close — then provision the stack.
stages.summary: Runs the consult, sends the quote, and on a signed close flips the record lead → customer and triggers the stack provisioning in localDNS. The quote template carries the working price hypotheses, not gospel.
stages.status_note: Pricing ($25–40/mo + ~$150–200 setup) is an unvalidated hypothesis from MARKETING.

stages.title: Statements Delivery
stages.golive: Monthly run; email + mail the Statement; QR codes go live
stages.tagline: The product. Generate, email, print / mail, QR — every month.
stages.summary: The center. Reads the paid roster and produces the monthly Network Activity Statement and operator portfolio, delivered by email, on paper, and by QR. This repo orchestrates the cadence; the artifacts themselves live and render in localDNS under the honesty-of-the-kept-document rule.
stages.status_note: The Statements live in the public localDNS repo — open the gallery from the cross-repo links.

stages.title: Payments & Receivables
stages.golive: Create the plan; collect setup fee + monthly retainer; reconcile
stages.tagline: One-time setup fee + monthly retainer; reconcile.
stages.summary: Stands up the billing plan, collects the setup fee and the recurring retainer, and writes billing status back to the record so delivery (06) can gate on a paid account. The flat retainer is what makes every incident a cost, not revenue.
stages.status_note: Amounts inherit the same unvalidated pricing hypothesis as stage 05.

stages.title: Client List & CRM
stages.tool: CRM / Airtable — the system of record
stages.golive: Maintain the roster; it feeds the Statement generator and every stage
stages.tagline: The system of record — one record per household, operator, and route.
stages.summary: The single source of truth every other stage reads and writes: one record per household, per operator, per route. A field is either in the schema or it does not exist — no stray spreadsheet columns, the business analog of localDNS's data-driven generator.

stages.title: Recruiting & Guild
stages.golive: Open applications; run vetting; onboard into the guild
stages.summary: Catches the “Connect in the Alliance” hand-raise from a Statement and runs it through vetting and onboarding into the guild. Every happy customer is a latent operator; this is where the flywheel turns.
stages.status_note: The “guild-certified” vetting standard is a first draft, not a legal standard — define with counsel.

stages.title: Gig-Workers Compliance
stages.golive: Collect W-9; pay contractors; file 1099-NEC by Jan 31
stages.summary: Collects the W-9, e-signs the contractor agreement, and files the 1099-NEC on time for operators paid as gig workers. Documents the 1099 path; worker classification is the real risk and must be confirmed before scaling.
stages.status_note: Confirm 1099-vs-W-2 classification with counsel — misclassification is the live risk.

stages.title: Automations
stages.golive: Enable the zaps that carry a record stage→stage; never hand-copy
stages.tagline: The glue that carries a record stage→stage — never hand-copy.
stages.summary: The connective tissue that moves a record from one stage to the next without a human retyping it. If any arrow in the funnel needs a copy-paste, that seam is a bug here — not a feature.

crossrepo.title: Statement Gallery
crossrepo.desc: The product itself — the installable gallery of client Network Activity Statements and the operator Alliance Member Portfolio. This console surrounds it; that gallery is what every stage exists to earn, produce, and deliver.

crossrepo.title: The Model
crossrepo.desc: The why: the two-sided guild, pricing, unit economics, and the conversion flywheel. The strategy this console executes — the source of the pricing and dues hypotheses the stages treat as CHANGE_ME defaults.

crossrepo.title: The Stack
crossrepo.desc: The technical delivery vehicle: the DNS + monitoring + VPN stack on the t630 that produces the real figures a Statement is allowed to print. The moat is the guild; this is how the quiet gets made.
